scenes.text: Hello little friend! I'm Ocean Dreamer Moa, and today we're setting sail on a wonderful adventure about friendship. Are you ready to explore with me? Friendship is like the ocean, vast and full of surprises. Together, we'll learn how to make friends and be the best friends we can be. Let's dive into this journey with excitement and open hearts!

Now, let's talk about what friendship means. Friendship is when two people care about each other and enjoy spending time together. Just like when you play games with your friends at the park or share your toys with them. Friends make us happy and help us when we're feeling sad. Isn't it wonderful to have someone who makes you smile?

To make friends, it's important to be kind and share. Sharing can be as simple as letting someone use your crayons or taking turns on the swing. When we share, it shows others that we care about them and want to have fun together. Remember, sharing is a big part of being a good friend.

Great job listening! Now, let's think about ways we can be friendly. Smiling is a great start! When you smile at someone, it makes them feel warm and welcome. Saying 'hello' or asking 'do you want to play?' are wonderful ways to invite someone to be your friend. You can do it!

Remember when we talked about sharing? Let's try a little game. Imagine you have a big, delicious cookie. Wouldn't it be nice to share half with a friend? By sharing, both of you can enjoy the treat and have a fun time together. Sharing makes our hearts feel happy and full.

Wonderful! You're doing amazing. Now, let's talk about listening. When your friend is talking, it's important to listen carefully. Listening shows respect and helps us understand our friends better. When we listen, we learn what makes our friends happy and how we can help them.

Now let's practice. Imagine your friend is telling you about their favorite toy. You can ask questions like 'What does it do?' or 'Can I see it?' This shows you're interested and care about what they have to say. Asking questions is a fun way to learn more about your friends.

Let's continue our journey by talking about playing together. Playing is a big part of friendship. Whether it's building sandcastles at the beach or playing tag in the backyard, playing together helps us grow closer. When we play, we laugh, learn, and create wonderful memories.

You are doing so well, little adventurer! Now, let's talk about saying sorry. Sometimes, we might accidentally hurt our friend's feelings. It's important to say 'I'm sorry' and mean it. Apologizing helps fix any sadness and makes friendships even stronger. You have the power to make things right.

Have you ever had to say sorry to a friend? It's okay if you have. Everyone makes mistakes, and saying sorry shows you care. Can you think of a time when you said sorry and it made your friend smile again? Let's remember those moments and how they made us feel.

Now let's talk about how to cheer up a friend. If your friend is sad, you can cheer them up by being there for them. Maybe you could draw them a picture or tell them a funny story. Sometimes just sitting quietly with them is enough to show you care. You have a kind heart.

Let's practice cheering up a friend. Imagine your friend lost their favorite toy and feels sad. You could say, 'I'm here for you,' and help them look for it. Or you might offer them a hug. These small actions can make your friend feel much better.

You're doing brilliantly! Let's recap what we've learned. Friendship is about sharing, listening, playing, saying sorry, and cheering each other up. Each of these actions helps us build strong, happy friendships. You have all the tools to be a fantastic friend!

Our adventure about friendship is coming to an end, but remember, the journey never truly ends. Keep practicing what you've learned and spread kindness wherever you go. I'm so proud of you for being a wonderful friend. Until our next adventure, keep shining bright and making the world a happier place. Goodbye, little friend!
